title: Breece Hall remains out of practice for the Jets

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Breece Hall remains out of practice for the Jets
sources.description: The Jets called running back Breece Hall week-to-week after he suffered a quad injury in their Week 3 loss to the Lions and Wednesday's practice report gave reason to believe his return to action won't come this week.
